title: Remembered view restores Inventory Value category and vendor filters across a reload
preconds:
Owner/admin logged in with report access (reports project storage state)
No saved Inventory Value view in this browser, so the run starts on the true unfiltered default
Two in-stock parts share one fresh category but are stocked from two different fresh vendors (seeded via API), on top of an org that already holds many other categories/vendors with inventory
